goal: learn abort versus propose_tradeoff from actionable_alternatives without regressing search and recovery

checkpoint_screen.selection: earliest checkpoint that passes every gate

optimization_rationale.single_low_learning_rate_run: continue from the current champion instead of repeating a broad LR sweep
optimization_rationale.multi_checkpoint_screen: measure when abort improves before later steps can overfit toward termination
optimization_rationale.mixed_curriculum: retain all prior search, recovery, clarification and tradeoff anchors
optimization_rationale.no_dpo_or_grpo_yet: the current 10.94 percent abort success indicates a missing supervised rule, not a preference-only error
